title: Steps to Create FASTQ of CCS Overlapping Genomic SSR
author: Gregory P Harhay
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9i7h4hn

steps.title: Identify Simple Sequence Repeats (SSRs)
steps.instruction: Run Phobos (via Geneious plugin) to identify simple sequence repeats in the CP018802.1 genome, searching for repeats from 2-mers to 10-mers.

substeps.instruction: Use 'normalised alphabetical mode' for repeat unit naming.
Save the identified repeats to the CP018802.1 genome annotation.

steps.title: Create BAM Files of Overlapping CCS
steps.instruction: Create BAM files of CCS overlapping the SSR regions of interest (ROI) using the identified coordinates and the BAM file of all reads mapping to the genome (SRR8080935_CP018802.bam).

substeps.instruction: Transfer coordinates to BED files (CP018802_79_bp_SSR.bed, CP018802_107_bp_SSR.bed, CP018802_147_bp_SSR.bed, CP018802_154_bp_SSR.bed, CP018802_250_bp_SSR.bed), ensuring the left coordinate is 0-based and the right is 1-based.
Allow for 5 bp on each flank when specifying the SSR position.

Use bedtools intersect to find CCS that completely overlap the SSR including the 5 bp adjacent non-SSR regions on each flank (e.g., bedtools intersect -a [input_bam] -b [bed_file] -F 1.0 -wa > [output_bam]).
Repeat for all 5 SSRs to generate: SRR8080935_CP018802_79bp.bam, SRR8080935_CP018802_107bp.bam, SRR8080935_CP018802_147bp.bam, SRR8080935_CP018802_154bp.bam, and SRR8080935_CP018802_250bp.bam.

steps.title: Extract ROI Sequences to FASTQ
steps.instruction: Use Geneious to inspect the alignment of CCS mapping to the duplex and extract the bases within the ROI to create FASTQ files.

substeps.instruction: Inspect gap regions between the end of the SSR and the first adjacent base of flanking regions.
Use the Geneious 'Extract' function to select bases spanning the ROI for each read.

Generate the following FASTQ files: SRR8080935_79bp_AAGC_SSR_ROI_reads.fastq, SRR8080935_107bp_ACTG_SSR_ROI_reads.fastq, SRR8080935_147bp_ACTG_SSR_ROI_reads.fastq, SRR8080935_154bp_AATC_SSR_ROI_reads.fastq, and SRR8080935_250bp_AACC_SSR_ROI_reads.fastq.
